2122417058113896834.en_summary: $MSFT - Microsoft reveals months-old bug behind global outage. Software bug undetected since July triggered last week's worldwide disruption affecting Outlook, Teams, Copilot and other services. Failure began Nov 11, peak more than 80% of Outlook servers unresponsive. Took ~30 hours to identify and begin fix. Raises concerns over cloud infrastructure resilience.
2122417058113896834.zh_summary: $MSFT - 微軟揭示導致全球中斷的數月老漏洞。自7月未偵測到的軟體錯誤觸發上週全球中斷，影響Outlook、Teams、Copilot和其他服務。故障始於11月11日，高峰時超過80%的Outlook伺服器無回應。花了約30小時識別並開始修復。引發對雲端基礎設施韌性的擔憂。
